tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Search Polymarket prediction markets with filters. Find active markets, filter by tags, volume, liquidity, and more. Perfect for market discovery and analysis.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter markets by question text (e.g., 'Bitcoin $100k', 'Trump wins')

params.name: closed
params.description: Filter by closed status (false = only active markets, true = include closed)

params.name: tag_id
params.description: Filter by tag ID (use list_tags to discover)

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific market by slug. Returns probabilities, volume, liquidity, outcomes, and full market data.

params.name: slug
params.description: Market slug (from URL or search results)

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search Polymarket events. Events group related markets together (e.g., 'Presidential Election 2024' contains multiple markets). Great for discovering market clusters.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific event by slug, including all related markets.

params.name: slug
params.description: Event slug (from URL or search results)

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all available tags/categories for filtering markets and events. Use tag IDs with search_markets or search_events.

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Get recent trade activity from Polymarket's Data API. Analyze trading patterns, volume, and market sentiment.

tools.name: analyze_market
tools.description: Get comprehensive market analysis including probabilities, trading activity, and AI-friendly insights. Combines market data with recent trades.

prompts.name: analyze_market
prompts.description: Get comprehensive analysis of a specific Polymarket prediction market

prompts.name: find_trending
prompts.description: Discover the most active and high-volume prediction markets

prompts.name: compare_event
prompts.description: Analyze and compare all markets within a specific event

prompts.name: market_discovery
prompts.description: Explore prediction markets in a specific category or topic

resources.name: trending-markets
resources.description: Currently trending prediction markets with high volume and activity

resources.name: market-categories
resources.description: All available categories/tags for filtering Polymarket prediction markets

resources.name: featured-events
resources.description: Featured prediction market events with multiple related markets
